theme: Skia m151 with faster color paths
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the Skia engine to milestone 151 and ports several hot color-conversion paths to managed C#.
highlights_body: Alongside the engine bump, SKColor/SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply, and hex-color parsing now run in managed code for lower overhead, and a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData is fixed.

bullets.detail: Bundles the Skia m151 engine and rolls up several batches of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes.

Ports SKColor/SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, SKColor hex parsing, HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8, HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and SKShaper glyph reads to allocation-light managed implementations, and adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor parsing.
Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions, simplifying consumer code that touches it.
Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster rendering regression.
Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI).

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: The Skia submodule bump to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition, HarfBuzzSharp allocation-free buffer work, and the m151 Emscripten static libraries for .NET 11

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Updates the Skia engine to milestone 151, alongside documentation and release-tooling improvements.
v4.151.0-preview.1.1.website_summary: Preview 1 updates the Skia engine to milestone 151.

bullets.text: Updated the Skia engine to milestone 151.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.subtitle: A maintenance preview focused on allocation-free text and color parsing.
v4.151.0-preview.2.1.website_summary: Preview 2 focuses on allocation-free text handling and faster `SKColor` parsing.

bullets.text: Optimized SKColor hex parsing and added allocation-free ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads.
Made HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via a pooled UTF-8 encode.
Removed per-call char[4] allocations in HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse.
Read SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans, and fixed a release-notes PR classifier issue.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.subtitle: Release Candidate 1 fixes a CPU raster regression and a native resource leak.
v4.151.0-rc.1.1.website_summary: Release Candidate 1 fixes a CPU raster rendering regression and a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

bullets.text: Restored SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster rendering regression.
Fixed a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI).

harfbuzz_summary: Makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and Tag.Parse allocation-free, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.
